const st_cum = [

func setup() {
  let i = 0
  while (i < 195) {
    let p = this.spawn({
      color: [1, 1, 1, 1],
      scale: 1,
      glow: false,
      light: 0,
      life: -1
    })
    let st_frac = 0.5 / 195 + 1 / 195 * i
    let st_frac2 = st_frac
    if (st_frac2 < 0) { st_frac2 = 0 }
    if (st_frac2 > 0.999999999) { st_frac2 = 0.999999999 }
    let st_target = st_frac2 * 64.97056274847714
    let st_e = 0
    while (st_e < 29 && st_cum[st_e + 1] <= st_target) { st_e = st_e + 1 }
    let st_a = st_ea[st_e]
    let st_b = st_eb[st_e]
    let st_span = st_cum[st_e + 1] - st_cum[st_e]
    let st_t = 0
    if (st_span > 0.000000001) { st_t = (st_target - st_cum[st_e]) / st_span }
    if (st_t < 0) { st_t = 0 }
    if (st_t > 1) { st_t = 1 }
    let st_x = (st_p[st_a * 3] + (st_p[st_b * 3] - st_p[st_a * 3]) * st_t) / 64
    let st_y = (st_p[st_a * 3 + 1] + (st_p[st_b * 3 + 1] - st_p[st_a * 3 + 1]) * st_t) / 64
    let st_z = (st_p[st_a * 3 + 2] + (st_p[st_b * 3 + 2] - st_p[st_a * 3 + 2]) * st_t) / 64
    p.position = [st_x, st_y, st_z]
    i = i + 1
  }
}
